page.title: Booking transfers
page.intro: Transfer a confirmed booking you can't use, or browse other people's listings.

discover.title: Bookings for transfer
discover.intro: Seller names are masked. To take over a booking, open the private link the seller sent you.
discover.itemNote: You can take over this booking only through the link the seller sends you.

how.title: How do transfers work?
how.step1: The seller picks a confirmed booking, sets a price and creates a single-use transfer link.
how.step2: The seller sends the link to the buyer themselves; sellers can't be contacted from this list.
how.step3: The buyer opens the link and pays. Once the payment is approved, the booking moves to the buyer.
how.step4: The price is paid out to the seller. If nobody pays or the link expires, the booking stays with the seller.

loginToSell: <link>Sign in</link> to transfer your own booking.

sell.title: Transfer my booking
sell.created: Transfer link created ({amount}). The link is valid until {expires}; when the buyer pays, the booking moves to them and the amount is paid out to you.
sell.copyFailed: Could not copy; select and copy the link manually.
sell.none: You have no transferable bookings. Only confirmed bookings with more than {hours} hours until check-in can be transferred.
sell.linkOnce: The transfer link is shown only now — copy it and share it with the buyer.
sell.replaceBody: This booking is already listed. If you continue, the previous link stops working immediately and you must send the new link to the buyer.
sell.linkLost: If you lose the link you can create a new one; the old one will stop working.
sell.closeBody: This link will not be shown again. If you haven't copied it, you can't send it to the buyer.
sell.tooLateSuffix: (less than {hours} hours to check-in; can't be transferred)
sell.askTooHigh: Your price can be at most {max}.
sell.keepNote: This doesn't transfer the booking yet: it stays yours until the buyer pays through the link. Once the payment is approved, your price is paid out to you.
sell.shareText: To take over my booking at {property} for {amount}, pay through this link.

claim.title: Take over booking
claim.intro: Ownership does not change until the payment is approved. If the payment is declined, the transfer does not happen.
claim.invalidCard: The card could not be validated
claim.invalidLink: No valid transfer link was found. Open the full link the seller shared.
claim.owned: The booking is now yours: <link>view booking</link>
claim.cardHint: Demo cards: approve {success}, decline {decline}. Your card number never reaches our servers; the payment provider creates a single-use code instead. Cards that need extra verification (3D Secure) aren't supported for transfers.
claim.loginPrompt: To complete the transfer, <login>log in</login> or <register>create an account</register>. Your link is kept in this tab.
claim.reviewNote: Before paying, confirm the property, dates and price with the seller. The amount the seller asked for will be charged to your card.
claim.confirmBody: The transfer price set by the seller will be charged to your card and the booking will move to you. This cannot be undone.
claim.maybeCharged: Your previous attempt may already have been charged and the transfer completed. Check <link>your trips</link> before paying again.
claim.threeDsUnsupported: This card needs extra verification (3D Secure), which isn't supported for transfers. Please use another card.
claim.linkExpired: This transfer link expired on {date}. Ask the seller for a new link.
claim.linkGone: This transfer is no longer available: the booking went to another buyer or the seller withdrew the listing.
claim.selfClaim: This link belongs to your own transfer listing; you can't take over your own booking. Share the link with the buyer.
claim.invalidLinkHelp: If you already completed the transfer, the booking appears under My trips.

mine.title: My transfer listings

mine.withdrawBody: The link you shared stops working immediately and the booking stays with you.
mine.withdrawn: Listing withdrawn; the link can no longer be used.

verify.alreadyVerified: Your email is already verified. Please try again.
verify.failed: We couldn't send the email. Please try again shortly.
